description: Header file defining the AudioRendererPassthrough class for Android shared audio rendering, including class declaration, member variables, and method signatures.

classes.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
classes.description: Class implementing an audio renderer with passthrough capabilities for Android, handling audio decoding, playback, and synchronization.

methods.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio renderer with stream info, DRM system, and seek behavior.

methods.name: ~AudioRendererPassthrough
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is initialized and valid.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with error, prerolled, and ended callbacks.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Feeds input audio buffers into the renderer.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of audio stream.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been written.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamPlayed
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been played.

methods.name: CanAcceptMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if the renderer can accept more input data.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified media time.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Retrieves current media playback time and status flags.

methods.name: CreateAudioTrackAndStartProcessing
methods.description: Creates audio track and begins processing thread.

methods.name: FlushAudioTrackAndStopProcessing
methods.description: Flushes and stops audio track processing at a given seek position.

methods.name: UpdateStatusAndWriteData
methods.description: Updates playback status and writes audio data.

methods.name: OnDecoderConsumed
methods.description: Handles decoder consumption event.

methods.name: OnDecoderOutput
methods.description: Handles decoder output event.
